tagline: 理光旁轴相机，1972 年发布
description: 理光于1972年推出的旁轴相机。配备fixed-mount Rikenon 40mm f/2.8 with 46 mm filter thread。快门速度Mechanical, B, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125, 1/250, 1/500。使用135 (24mm x 36mm negative)。感光度64-800。3 ft. (0.9m) to inf。

specs.镜头: fixed-mount Rikenon 40mm f/2.8 with 46 mm filter thread
specs.取景器: coupled rangefinder, framelines with parallax markings
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh 500 G is a compact coupled rangefinder camera, introduced by Ricoh in 1972.
